name: paperfoot
description: Web search for AI agents: the search CLI skill.

plugins.name: search-cli
plugins.description: Teaches Claude to use the search CLI: auto or explicit modes over eleven search engines, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit and Hacker News, page extraction with video transcripts, cost in every result. Needs the search binary (cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/keyclaw6/search-cli --branch ryote).
